1479-5700-5701-8293-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-8293-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

323-2173-2469-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.

Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.

Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.

When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

Repeat.
